# The task editor hands focus to the grid, not to the task it opened on

## Context

Found driving #21624 (a Gantt example of the task editor), whose AC asks that "Cancel and Escape change nothing and return focus to the task". On `dev` `5851f7d976`, `examples/gantt/basic` at 1440 × 900: open the editor on "Design the beds" by double-click or by Enter on the focused bar, then close it.

| Close by | Focus after |
|---|---|
| Escape | `DIV#neo-grid-view-1` |
| Cancel | `DIV#neo-grid-view-1` |
| Save | `BODY` |

A keyboard user who pressed Enter on a bar lands on the whole grid, and after a save on nothing.

## The Problem

A traced close (Escape): the editor's DOM is removed, so focus goes back through `revertFocusOnDeparture()` (`src/component/Base.mjs`), from the editor, its header toolbar and its action button, each through the `restoreFrom` hand-back. Each asks `getFocusReturnTarget()`: the component focus came from, else the dialog's `animateTarget`. The opener is the bar, `animateTargetId`, but a bar is a node inside a grid row, not a component: `Neo.timeline.EventEditor#animateTarget` (`src/timeline/EventEditor.mjs:136`) falls back to its owner, and on a pointer open the grid has already moved focus from the bar to its view.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.timeline.EventEditor` is the scheduler's and the Gantt's shared editor: `openEventEditor(eventIdOrRecord, barId)` opens it from a bar's double-click or Enter (`src/scheduler/Container.mjs`), and `Neo.gantt.Container#openTaskEditor` delegates to it.
- `Neo.component.Base#focus(id, children, preventScroll, modality, restoreFrom)` focuses any node by id, and with `restoreFrom` only a lost focus.
- Design authority: `Neo.dialog.Base#getFocusReturnTarget` JSDoc: "A dialog hands focus back to the component focus came from, else to its opener, the {@link #animateTarget} it grows out of" (#21415). The editor's opener is the bar; this makes it reachable.

## The Fix

`Neo.timeline.EventEditor` overrides `revertFocus()` and `revertFocusOnDeparture()`: while it holds focus and has a `barId`, its owner focuses that bar, on departure with `restoreFrom` set to the editor, so a focus the user moved meanwhile stays. Otherwise both fall back to the dialog's behaviour. A draft does this and returns focus to the bar on Escape, Cancel and Save.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Opened by double-click or by Enter, the editor hands focus back to its bar on Escape, on Cancel and on Save.
- [ ] Opened without a bar (`openTaskEditor(id)`), it hands focus back as a dialog does.
- [ ] A Playwright e2e spec proves the first: red on `dev`, green at head.
- [ ] The scheduler, gantt and timeline specs stay green.

## Out of Scope

- Which element the editor focuses when it opens (its header's maximize tool today): a separate defect-note.
- The grid's own focus model on a pointer press.
